global.verdict: UNCERTAIN (unmodeled affine tone compression, no exact legal function)
global.signals: variance_ratio across pairs 0-4 = 0.7898/0.7145/0.6463/0.7245/0.7036, mean_shift only -0.3 to +5.0/255 (small, sign-inconsistent); deterministic blur+jpeg peel leaves residual_std 11.2/11.5/10.2/11.9/11.2 gray levels on pairs 0-4 (constant -> one systematic missing component, not noise). R0 tone fit target_gray = P + 0.84*(clean_gray - P), pivot ~ image mean, var_ratio ~ f^2. Legal bank functions cannot reproduce f~0.84: contrast_weaken_scale:1 = 0.75 (overshoot; -0.82 dB before JPEG, -0.33 dB after JPEG and CI 4/10); contrast_weaken_stretch:1 has +35 mean shift (15.01 dB); saturate_weaken_HSV:1 (S*0.7, closest to measured chroma ratio ~0.77) tested R1 at 24.26 dB (-2.03); saturate_weaken_YCrCb:1 (S*0.6) 23.65 dB. Chroma reduction is already produced by JPEG q=8 4:2:0 in the simulation. Conclusion: unrepresented generator-side photometric/tone variation outside the blur/noise/compression bank; approximate at training time is not beneficial.

analysis.rationale: R0 pipeline stands as the best legal prediction. JPEG presence is Tier-S (block_boundary, 0% FP) and severity 4 wins the PSNR/CI arbitration; blur is gaussian sev3 at signal level (Wiener corr 0.9983, slope diff 0.0336) with motion excluded by anisotropy and glass excluded as a blur-amount FP; noise is excluded by structured peeled residuals in all 5 pairs and by a WEAK hidden-noise signal test. The constant ~11 gray-level residual across pairs is a real affine tone compression (~0.84) that no legal bank function reproduces; every legal approximation (contrast before/after JPEG, saturation HSV/YCrCb) lowers PSNR and/or CI. Per REFLECTION_MECHANISM the change bar (> 2 dB deterministic, MATCH for noise) is not met -> NO_CHANGE, no R1 retraining.
